name: Noctalia Lyrics 3D
description: Cinematic desktop lyrics for Noctalia Shell with dynamic safe-zone placement, four display modes, packed variable-scale typography, neon glow and an interactive compact now-playing card.
author: alitura

compatibility.shell: Noctalia Shell v5 Luau plugin host + Quickshell companion

notes: Noctalia v5 does not load QML plugins. The Luau service owns MPRIS, LRCLIB, filters and settings; a separate Quickshell process renders the real 3D layer and reads ~/.cache/noctalia-lyrics/state.json. The old Noctalia v4 QML plugin is archived under legacy-v4/.
